module: Flowgraph node "Start Delivery" (category once_instant, delivery). Starts the delivery: objectives, hints, markers and task list become visible and the timer starts. Requires a loaded delivery (Load Delivery) that is not already active. Pins: flow, reset (hidden) as inputs; flow, success as outputs.

init.desc: Resets flow and success to false.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets flow and success to false.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets flow and success to false.

work.desc: If flow is active: checks isLoaded() and not isActive(), calls freeformDelivery.start() and fills success/flow; logs errors.
